Perfect! **All tests pass.** The fix successfully corrects the Indian numbering format for amounts over a lakh. 

The test on line 14 of `test_money.py` specifically verifies: `format_inr(12345678) == "₹1,23,456.78"` ✓

The issue was that the loop condition `while len(head) > 3:` was too restrictive. Changing it to `while len(head) > 2:` allows the function to properly extract 2-digit groupings from the left, which is the correct Indian numbering system pattern.
